dimensions_mm: 165 x 75 x 75 (L x W x H, with package)
features: AHD/TVI/CVI/CVBS switchable video output over coax
release_notes: Datasheet's 'Size (With Package)' table lists 165x75x75mm (L*W*H), while the dimensioned line drawing shows different body measurements (approx. 158.2mm length x 82.2mm height x 75.3mm width including bracket); the table value is recorded here as printed. Effective pixel rate is listed as '5MP@20fps'; max_fps recorded as 20 accordingly. This is an HD-analog (AHD/TVI/CVI/CVBS) camera, not IP-networked — no ONVIF/RTSP/network protocols are listed on the datasheet.

frigate.notes: Analog HD-over-coax camera — not a direct IP/RTSP source; ingest the RTSP output of its HDCVI/DVR instead.

home_assistant.notes: Analog camera; view via a compatible HDCVI DVR/recorder.

blue_iris.notes: Connect via a compatible HD-over-coax (HDCVI) DVR.
